site_number: Buildings J & H, Thames Water Land
description: Erection of 87 affordable housing units as a variation to approved schemes 00657/B/P15 and 00657/B/P15(C).
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Subject to conditions and a legal agreement to secure necessary planning obligations, the proposed revisions to the affordable housing Blocks J and H within the wider development granted permission under references 00657/B/P15 and 00657/B/P15(C), are satisfactory as they would enhance the quality of the accommodation within the originally approved scheme and would provide a more balanced housing mix, providing more larger affordable dwellings. Associated changes to car parking and landscaping would enhance the appearance and function of the site. Therefore the development would be in accordance with policies 2A.1 (Sustainability Criteria), 3A.1 (Increasing London's supply of housing), 3A.3 (Maximising the potential of sites), 3A.5 (Housing choice), 3A.6 (Quality of new housing provision), 3A.9 (Affordable hosuing targets), 3A.10 (Negotiating affordable housing in individual and private residential and mixed use schemes), 3C.1 (Integrating transport and development), 4A.3 (Sustainable design and construction), 4A.7 (Renewable energy), 4B.1 (Design principles for a compact city), 4B.3 (Enhancing the quality of the public realm), 4B.5 (Creating an inclusive environment), 4B.8 (Respect local context and communities) and 6A.5 (Planning Obligations) of the London Plan; policies IMP.6.1 (Planning Obligations), ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), ENV-W.1.1 (Design in the Thames Policy Area), ENV-P.2.4 (Recycling Facilities in New Developments), and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the Unitary Development Plan; and the UDP Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - Construction above the ground of the buildings hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the buildings hereby approved have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 5 - No ground works shall take place until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 6 - Prior to the occupation of the affordable residential accommodation a total of 121 secure cycle parking spaces shall be provided within the basement and made available for use, and retained thereafter to the occupiers of the affordable residential units. Details of the cycle parking spaces shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the occupation of the first affordable residential accommodation and the arrangements for cycle storage shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given unless agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - No dwelling shall be occupied prior to the provision of 61 car parking spaces for residents of Blocks H and J in the basement car park and these spaces shall be permanently maintained as resident car parking only.

Condition : 8 - Nine (9) of the residential units in the buildings hereby approved shall be designed so that they can be easily adaptable to meet the National Wheelchair Housing Association Group (NATWHAG) Wheelchair Housing Standards. Details of compliance with this requirement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of work above ground. The approved details shall be implemented before each unit is occupied and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 9 - No development shall take place until a Construction Environmental Management Plan (CEMP) covering both the demolition and construction stages has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The CEMP shall cover:(i) Any external illumination of the site;(ii) Measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site;(iii) Measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties;(iv) The routeing of vehicles to the site, access and egress arrangements and waiting areas;(v) Boundary treatment and measures to ensure they are maintained in a secure and tidy condition; and(vi) Considerate Contractor Scheme.The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 10 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 08:00 to 18:00 on Mondays to Friday and 09:00 to 13:00 on Saturdays and not at all on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 11 - No development above ground shall take place until full details of hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Hard landscaping details shall include hard surfacing materials, proposed finished levels or contours, means of enclosure and boundary treatments, vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas, minor artefacts and structures (e.g. benches, lighting, CCTV, works of art etc.), walls, gates and fences.  A Landscape Completion Plan related to the various phases of the development shall be submitted and agreed with the Local Planning Authority before commencement of works above ground. This will set the stages for completion of landscape works in relation to the various buildings. All hard landscape work shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Landscape Completion Plan prior to any occupation of each individual building and retained and maintained thereafter.Soft landscaping details shall include proposed finished levels or contours, planting plans, written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment), plant schedules (noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities) and tree pits and species proposed to be planted therein and measures to ensure protection from services routes.All soft landscape works associated with each individual building shall be carried out in accordance with the Landscape Completion Plan within 12 months of occupation of that building and retained thereafter.If within a period of five years from the date of planting any tree or specimen shrub that tree or specimen shrub or any tree or specimen shrub planted in replacement for it is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies (or becomes, in the opinion of the Local Planning Authority, seriously damaged or defective), another tree or specimen shrub of the same species and size as that originally planted shall be planted at the same place, un

Condition : 12 - No development above ground shall take place until details of a Sustainable Drainage Scheme, including measures for the harvesting of rainwater, the minimisation of water run-off from the building, by at least 50% of that of the undeveloped site, (and the conservation and reuse as appropriate of other water supplies in the building have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. These details shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 13 - At practical completion of each building hereby approved, a certificate of compliance should be submitted to the Local Planning Authority prior to occupation of that building providing evidence that: (a)	All completed units within that building have achieved Level 3 of the Code for Sustainable Homes.(b)	A system of on-site renewable energy has been installed for use in each building in accordance with 'Thames Water Land at Kew Bridge Road, Brentford: Proposals to Vary Existing Consent 00657/B/P15 (C) St James Group - Sustainability Statement' by Environmental Perspectives to reduce carbon emissions from the total emission (i.e. regulated and unregulated emissions - heating, cooling and power) of the development hereby approved by at least 13.2%.The details as approved shall have been implemented prior to occupation of the buildings and retained and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 14 - No dwelling in the development hereby approved shall be occupied until details of electric charging points within the basement for the charging of electric vehicles has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details as approved shall have been implemented prior to occupation of the buildings and retained and maintained thereafter.
